talas.t: Cannot sleep, the radiator is knocking again 😩
Same. It sounds like someone inside the wall is hitting it with a spoon
Bars is not bothered, he sleeps through everything 🐶
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on the potato rows this morning, but it's clear
Kayırluu tañ. Horses are fine. Did you see the cold, minus 3 on the Trans-Talas road
Kayırluu tañ! Mountains very white. Talas says 7 today, clear sky 🌤️
Clear is good for the 14 bus, nobody skids on clear. Going now
Pray for the 14 bus 🙏
Anyone else's taxi meter starting at 15 som already this morning? Feels like it went up overnight
Taxi in Talas from 15 som, that's what the board says. Maybe it's the early hour tax, joke
There's no early hour tax 😂 I'll walk then
Queue at our branch already. Pensioners want the new card, I told them tomorrow
Ask them to bring the old card too. Saves a trip
Good idea, rahmat 👍
Is anyone going to the Bazar-i Kalan this week? Cabbage and carrots, I need a sack for the kids' lunches
Potatoes at 2.10 a kilo now, the inner rows. Carrots I did not check
2.10 is more than you said last week 😅
Last week was 2 som. Now it's the start of the cold, everybody buys
My uncle says the Kazakh lorries are slower at the border. Potatoes go up when the lorries go slow
Your uncle is a potato expert now? 😄
Customer brought a phone into the counter with a cracked screen and a sticker saying 'do not touch'. Ok, fixed it anyway
Ha. Did you leave the sticker on
Yes, he wanted it back exactly as it was 😂
Changers are open. Dollar at 11.50 buy, 11.95 sell this morning. Euro 12.50 / 13.10
Official is still 8.40 at the bank, fixed since 2008. The changers are a different country 😂
Ha, the changers are the real economy, baike
Hay is on my list. A bale in the valleys is 26 som now. Last year it was less, my horses eat a lot
Buy now before the snow. Hay in the valleys goes up after the first pass closes
Yes, I know. Going to Kara-Suu tomorrow with the van
Anyone driving to Nurzhan this week? Bus is 32 som, marshrutka 38. Marshrutka is faster but cramped
Marshrutka. Always. The bus stops at every village
Air in Nurzhan is bad again, the bus driver had his mask on this morning 😷
It's the heating season. Everyone burns whatever they have
I'm keeping the kids inside at recess in Nurzhan visits. Air quality says unhealthy
We have the air purifier on in the kindergarten office. The children don't care, they play outside anyway
Football: Tulpar on 62 pts, second, Neftchi on 63. Hoping for next season, not thinking about the court 😅
Season's finished, you can say it Timur. Second is still good
Second is good. Hippodrome on 12 Dec, Tulpar vs whoever comes out of the play-offs, we'll be there
Play-offs at the Hippodrome, I can bring the horses on the parade if they allow it 😄
Brass and drums only, Marat. Ask the stables first
[poll: Lunch from home or the canteen on Monday to Friday?]
Home. Potatoes, always potatoes 😄
Canteen. Plov is 28 som and it's hot, that's worth it
Canteen at TSU is the best value in town. Thursday I'll bring boorsok for the exchange anyway 🥟
Has anyone heard about the Jibek Jolu market hearing? My aunt is still waiting
Adjourned again, no news. Her stall is at home now
Rahmat. Lots of people in the same boat
Iyık Janyl 2.4 kg of heroin on State Route 1, two men held. That's a lot. Scary stuff near the Kara-Buura road
Two men, that's all they wrote. Hope the road is fine for the buses
Stay safe on the roads. Hope the drivers are all right 🙏
Housing debate in the Herald. Up in the Microdistricts or out on the fields. I'd take the fields, not the Microdistricts 😅
Fields means more bus time for everyone. Microdistricts means a queue for the lift
Fields are my potatoes 😤 leave them alone
A flat in Talas, one room, 1,000 to 1,500 som a month. Not cheap for a kid just starting
Iyık Janyl is 600 to 1,000 for one room. Smog is worse there though, the air is 161 today
Nurzhan air is 167 today. Unhealthy. Nobody opens windows
Talas air is 112, unhealthy for sensitive groups. Which is me when I cough 😅
Power is normal in Talas today, no cuts scheduled. Good for the counter
Good for me too. No cuts, no lost files in the repair shop
Bars has his cold feet again. Tomorrow we get the chain on the car, the Fergana road is open but winter tyres required
Chains, winter tyres, everything. Ala-Bel is open, Suusamyr and Otmek are closed for the winter
Railway is on the winter timetable. Early train tomorrow, I'm not sure which one
Thursday teahouse: 18:30, behind the philology building. Who is coming?
Me! Will bring my Iradi homework, a short one 😅
Great. Bring the homework, we'll fix it together
Tulparcoin is at 3.55 cents today, up 1%. Not legal tender, I'm telling you again 😂
Somebody in our branch asked me to buy it. I said I'm a teller, not a casino
Lol. Keep your som, horses don't take crypto
Ulak result from Kara-Bulak still not in. Jarysh says not received yet, kids are asking
Ask Jarysh. Not football, ulak. Saturday 21 Nov for Dastgoh 5-2 Kara-Bulak in the ISEZ
Yes, round 11 ISEZ. Talas beat Kyzyl-Adyr 10-6 on the same day. Ulak, not football 🐴
ISEZ table: Chu 26 on top, Talas 25 second. Talas people are happy this week
Talas people are always happy after a good ulak day 😄
[sticker: haha]
Anyone going to the Hippodrome on Saturday 28th? I'm thinking about the Highland round 12 but it's far
Highland is far. The Upper Chatkal round is 14:00 and that's a long drive. Go to Talas
Ok. Talas then, the play-offs are the big one
Evening! Cash count is done at the booth. I'm going home, the cold is in my bones
Get warm, Begaiym 🧣
Diesel is 6.10 a litre at the station on the Trans-Talas. Petrol 95 at 5.85. The tractor doesn't care, it drinks
Tractor drinks diesel, the 14 bus drinks my patience 😅
Chains tomorrow, people. The roads are white up at the Old City already
Fog in Iyık Janyl tonight, Begaiym's cousin says the inversion is bad there
Yes, the valley holds the smoke. Windows shut, Gulzada
Hay is on the list, horses are hungry. Night soon
Someone in the Microdistricts is building a flat on the roof. Crazy. The fields are looking better
Rustam, the fields are the foothills, nobody wants to build on the foothills in winter 😂
Neftchi on 63, Tulpar on 62. Season's over, table is final. I said it already 🏆
Timur, you said it four times this week
Because it's true 😂
Quiet evening, cold tea and a blanket. Tomorrow: Thursday prep
Women's league: Tulpar on 23 top, Universitet 22 second. Good for the girls
[sticker: horse_love]
Good night, horses asleep, and the hay is in the van tomorrow
Night all. Thursday teahouse
Night. Check chains tomorrow 🚗
Night. Hippodrome tickets for 12 Dec, don't wait too long
Night Talas 💵
Night. Bars is back on the radiator 🐶
Night. Early shift again, 14 bus, pray for me 🙏
Night everyone. Dress warm 🧣
Cannot sleep. Radiator knocking like someone wants in
Bleed it. Turn the valve with a cloth, the air comes out with a hiss
Jakshı, will try tomorrow. Rahmat
Fog so thick at the Airport side I cannot see the Trans-Talas from my gate
Board says flights held until about 10:30. Fog at Talas Airport. Not my flight but still
Morning. Minus 5 on my thermometer by the door. Changers are open at 8 as usual
Hay van is on the road. Bale at 26 som in the valleys, the man said it is the last cheap week
Kayırluu tañ! Who is driving to Bazar-i Kalan today? I need onions and a sack of potatoes
Potatoes 2.10 a kilo in the market now, not 2 like before. Jakshı price still
Ok rahmat. I will walk, the marshrutka is slow with the fog
Salam. Is anyone else's Wi-Fi dying? Mine gone twice before 7 am
Tulpar works, everything else crawls. Nurbek said that yesterday and he was right
So the whole city is on one slow pipe? Great. Good for a phone repair man 😅
Is the 14 bus running today? Fog and chains everywhere
Came at 8:20 for me. Late but came. Driver says the Semiz side is icy
Rahmat. Taking a taxi anyway, I have a class at 9
Taxi from 15 som in the centre, they want 20 at the station today. Just saying
Fog everywhere, no ice on my side yet. Good day for doing nothing 😂
Changers at Bazar: 11.50 buy, 11.95 sell for dollars. Euro 12.45/13.05. Rubles 13.25/14.45 per 100
Ruble to 100 at 14.45 sell, that is up from last week I think
Could be. People come for dollars mostly, rubles are quiet
Horses are fine. Bought the hay, the van is slow, back by noon
[sticker: horse_love]
Stupid question: is the Thursday teahouse still on for tomorrow? 18:30, behind the philology building?
Yes! I am coming, I promised. Bringing my Iradi as a present 😄
Ooba, Rustam. Bring the Iradi, I bring the boorsok
Saw the Herald this morning. Grain harvest closed at 486,300 tonnes. Stores full, that means prices low for the farmers. Bakyt?
Yes. My potatoes sold for almost nothing last year. This year the stores are full so the same story. Diesel is not cheap either
Diesel at 6.10 and the tractor man wants more. Grain price low, fuel high. Nice combination
Who decided this? Nobody asks the farmer
Sit down, both of you. Coffee is on at my place
Tulpar Talas training Sunday? Someone said Attelkom have the cup final first 😅
Irad Cup final is 7 Nov, Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom. Done already, Timur. Read the table
I know, I know. I was joking 😂 Still Neftchi on 63 and we on 62
[sticker: haha]
Lunch. Plov at the canteen is 28 som, same as last month, nobody complains
Plov is fine, the tea is the problem. Cold by the time it arrives
Anyone know if the Chatkal adit is near 1,500 m? Read it is 800 now
Herald said 800 of 1,500 metres. No contract, no cost yet, Iradenergo says it is a study, not a decision
So they dig and then decide. Good. Rahmat
Fuel tax went up 9% in January to October, 468m som. Pump prices unchanged, so who pays?
Those who buy the diesel, Marat. Like us
Ha. Like always
Kids are so loud after lunch. Three of mine home with sore throats, the nursery is quiet today
Get well soon to them 🧡. Drink honey and tea with lemon
Rahmat. Honey is the only medicine I trust
Quiet at the booth, the sun is out for one hour. Enjoy it, it will be dark at 16:30
Family violence reports up 17% to 2,940 in ten months. The police say more people are calling. Good that they call
Good that they call. Terrible that they need to
Agreed. Let's leave it there today
Customer brought a phone with a cracked screen and a sticker that says Tulpar Talas. I charged him double 😂
Triple for the sticker, Rustam
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Hay in the stable. Two horses sleeping. Next, the van for the tyre shop, twelve tyres, all winter
Winter tyres in November is late. Everyone is at the tyre shop now
Late is better than sliding on the Trans-Talas, Elnur 😄
Fog gone, sun gone too. Minus soon. Chains on my truck, finally
Talas is 5 today, Nurzhan 8. But the air in Nurzhan is 162, bad. My chest hurts a bit when I walk
Talas 164 too. Unhealthy. Windows shut and a wet towel by the door
Iyık Janyl 149 and that is sensitive groups. Nurbek, see a doctor if the chest hurts
Rahmat Gulzada. It is only when I walk uphill 🙂
Hippodrome semi-finals on 12 Dec: Chu against Highland place 2 at 19:00, Highland 1 v Talas at 21:00. Tickets, people
Are we playing or just watching? Talas at 21:00 is us, right?
Talas is us. Watching is what you do, Rustam 😂
Horses will want to see that. Two horses on the stands, I pay for both
Evening all. Thursday tomorrow, 18:30, Tündük café. Bring a friend who speaks English badly, we need you
That is me 😂
You are the best of us, Rustam
Diesel 6.10 still at the Trans-Talas station. Petrol 95 at 5.85. Tractor still drinks
Tractor, 14 bus, my patience. Same story
Ulak: Kara-Bulak play Chu? No, that is the ISEZ round Saturday. Sorry, I mixed it up
Ulak round 11 is done. Talas 10-6 Kyzyl-Adyr, Dastgoh 5-2 Kara-Bulak. Talas on 25 points, Chu top on 26
Talas second in ISEZ then. Good. Round 12 is not till Saturday
Fog in Iyık Janyl again? My cousin says the smoke is sitting in the valley
Iyık Janyl 149. Windows shut, Gulzada. Same as Begaiym said
Ok ok. Bars is on the radiator again 🐶
Bars again, Gulzada? He has a bed. The radiator is a bad habit
[sticker: horse_love]
Who wants to see the snow in the Old City this weekend? Sunday morning maybe
Sunday I am on a shift. The Microdistrict phone queue never sleeps
Then Saturday! Sunday is for sleeping anyway
Saturday is ulak and football week. Irad Cup is over, the league is over. Just the play-offs left
The Irad League is over, Elnur. Neftchi 63, us 62. I said it
You said it six times this week, Timur
And it is still true 😂🏆
Taxi to the airport from Talas city, anyone? Flights are back on, board says normal now
Taxi 15 som to the centre. Airport probably 20 or more. Ask first
Rahmat. Going home by bus then, 32 to Nurzhan is the bus, I do not travel far tonight
Night soon, horses are fed, hay is in. Good day
Night Marat. Night all. Thursday teahouse, I am ready 🙂
Night. Check the chains, the Old City road is ice at night
Night Nurbek. Warm ones on, please. Dress warm 🧣
Night. Hippodrome tickets for 12 Dec, don't wait too long
Night Talas 💵
Night. Bars is back on his bed, finally 🐶
Night. Early shift, 14 bus, pray for me 🙏
Night. Thursday teahouse
Night everyone 🧣
Night. Potatoes tomorrow, 2.10 a kilo, rahmat
Still up? Night shift at the booth ends 2am, my feet are dead
Go to sleep Begaiym. The Talasbank queue will be there tomorrow
Kayırluu tañ. -4 in the low fields this morning, frost on everything
Kayırluu tañ. Horses are fine, they have the blankets on. Hay is in the barn
Kayırluu tañ! Bars did not want to leave the bed. Sorry Aizada, I will not make the Saturday walk if it is -4 🥶
Kayırluu tañ Gulzada 🧣 Saturday is still on, we go at 11 when it warms up
14 bus is on time this morning, I checked. Trans-Talas lane is open again 🙌
Rahmat Elnur. Anyone know a good shop for a phone screen? Mine cracked on the bus, ironic for a repairer 😅
Ha. Shoemaker's kid has no shoes. Try Oyrot on Kurmanjan street, they are fair
Oyrot is a competitor, I am not going to them lol. Jakshı, rahmat
Rustam don't be proud, bring it to me on lunch. Booth is 2 min from the bazar 😂
Talas 2.1 in the air app? Nurzhan is 164 today, the Iyık Janyl one is worse. Windows shut again
Talas 150 this morning, unhealthy for sensitive groups. Don't go running Gulzada
Running? I can barely climb the kindergarten stairs in this 😂
Heating is on everywhere now. My coal bill for the cellar is 4 sacks more than last year. Not happy
Wood is cheaper than coal at the Hippodrome yard if you buy by the cart. Ask Akmat there
Rahmat Marat, I will ask. I cannot pay for another cart this month though
Tulpar Talas season tickets for the play-offs are on sale at the stadium box office. Hippodrome 12 Dec is the Talas semi, 21:00. Book early
Talas v Highland winner on 19 Dec final? Is that the one at the Hippodrome too?
19 Dec final is at the State Hippodrome, 19:00. Semi 1 is Chu v Highland place 2 at 19:00 on the 12th
Chu v Highland. I thought Chu was just ulak, not football lol
Ulak is the ISEZ and Highland teams. Chu team in the football play-offs is a different thing, Elnur. Read the table 😂
I am reading the ulak table, the Chu one has 26 points, 10 games. Talas is 25 for us 🐎
Talas 25 in ISEZ, that is the Talas ulak side. Good, we are second. Chu first, Lower Naryn sixth. Wait for Saturday
Taxi from Talas to Iyık Janyl this morning? Bus is 45 som, marshrutka is cheaper I think
Bus Talas-Iyık Janyl is 45. Taxi is more. Don't do taxi unless you have 3 people
Ok bus it is. Thursday teahouse, anyone bringing boorsok again?
Only if somebody brings the tea, last time we had 6 people and one teapot 😅
[sticker: chai]
Lunch rate check: USD 11.50 buy, 12.00 sell at Bazar-i Kalan this morning. Euro 12.50/13.10. Official is 8.40 so the gap is big
Official rate is 8.40 since 2008 and the bazar is 12. Who is the stranger that changes at 12?
Not a stranger, Bakyt. It is me on the booth at 12 😂 Official rate is official, we just do the cash
My cousin in Nurzhan is sending money for the flat deposit. The changer quoted him different, why?
Ask for the 100 RUB rate too, that is 13.25 buy 14.45 sell this morning. Compare before you walk in
Bank counter says the same thing: official for the paper, bazar for the cash. Nobody wins except the queue
Lunch. Tyres are quiet today, three cars and one truck. Cold weather brings the winter tyre people
Winter tyres are needed on the Fergana Gateway now. Ala-Bel chains or winter tyres, the sign says so
Yes Elnur. And the Otmek pass is closed, so nobody is going to Chatkal by car anyway
Kindergarten kids are making paper snowflakes. Three of them asked if the horses in Talas are cold. I said yes, get a blanket 🐴
Tell them the horses are wearing coats and eating hay. Hay in the valleys is 26 a bale, so they are well fed 😄
26 a bale this year. Last year it was 19. Dry summer. Ok, the potatoes are 2.10 a kilo here if anyone wants
Bakyt you are always selling 😂
Still no word on the Jibek Jolu fire report. Aunt says the case is still just a folder in the court
Sorry Nurbek. Herald said adjourned, that's all we know
Walnuts are 22 a kilo in Toktogul bazar, my mother says, she wants me to buy a bag for the flat
Ask Rustam if the walnuts come with a phone repair 😂
Only for teachers 🙂
The sort of quiet afternoon at the Talasbank branch. Two people in the queue, both asking for the same coin info 🙄
Coin info is my afternoon too. Tulparcoin is 3.45 cents offshore at noon, down 2.2% today. Still not legal tender btw
Not legal tender. Not a bank product. Tulpar tickets are in som, Begaiym
I know Timur 😂 I'm just saying the number. Going back to my booth
Dark already at 16:40. Heating in the bus is off again, sitting in my coat
Shift ends at 18. Then teahouse for the language exchange? Will try not to speak Russian every sentence
Ooba! Come, 18:30. Bring someone who speaks Iradi so you have a partner 🙂
Talas 150 at 17:00. The inversion is sitting on the city, Iyık Janyl says the same. Gas heaters make it worse
Inversion always. Walk the cold air, the smoke stays down in the valley. Good night to close windows
[sticker: haha]
Diesel 6.10 at my pump on Trans-Talas. Don't ask me to be happy about it
Petrol 95 is 5.85 at the Talas stations. 92 is 5.40. Tank is full, I drive the 14 bus, not my car, so I don't care lol
You drive the bus Elnur, the company pays. Ha
Off to the Tündük, see you all there 🧣
Here. Two students and a boorsok 🙌
I am coming late, bus is slow in the cold. Save me a seat by the stove
Begaiym, the stove is taken by a boy doing a Spanish test 😂
Tulpar Talas is 2 pts ahead of nobody, we are 62, Neftchi 63. One point gap at the top now that the league is over, sorry for the repeat 😂
You said it again Timur. The league is over. We know. Neftchi champs
Champs at 63, we are second with 62. The Irad Cup final is 7 Nov, they beat Attelkom 2-0 already, so lol
Shh, let me read. Bars has a new blanket, the one with the green stripes, he sleeps on it now 🐶
Two steps forward, one back. Kayırluu kech. The Old City road is ice again at 19:00
Kech jakshı. Thanks Nurbek. Chains on, I walk to the stop
Night is coming, the horses are in, hay is in. Two horses and a tyre shop, that is my whole life
Marat you need a hobby 😂
I have a hobby, Aizada. It is the horses 🐎
Got home by the 32 bus. Board at the terminal said the next one is 20 min. Waited in the cold 🥶
Night shift for me tomorrow, the 14 is at 6:10. Please don't be late Timur
I am never late, Elnur. Only the bus is late
Bars says goodnight, he is on the radiator again. I give up 🐶
Did anyone read the Herald about the Toktogul official? Herding family from Ozgörüsh reported him. Brave people
Yes I read. Bribe. Toktogul is far, nothing changes for us in Talas. But good for them
Herding family reporting a bribe, that's a story. My cousin's cousin is in Toktogul, she said they all talk about it
Careful what you repeat, Begaiym 🙂
I only say what the Herald says Rustam 😂
Talasbank says the 2027 budget draft is near. NurGaz paid 10.9bn som, a third of their 2026 revenue. Big company
Big company, big tax. Fuel tax up 9% to 468m som Jan-Oct, pump prices unchanged. So they pay it, we pay at the pump, fine
Pump prices are the same as last month for me. Petrol 92 5.40. Nothing changed for the bus
Diesel in the Chatkal villages is 8.55 to 9.75 per my cousin. Way more than here. No one counts it there
Chatkal diesel unrecorded, the Herald wrote. Our diesel is on the books, their diesel is not
Sorry, the Chatkal survey adit is at 800 of 1,500 metres. No contract, no cost, no financing yet. Just a hole in the mountain
A hole with a number. Nice 😂
Tonight the Tündük had 14 people. Thursday is growing. Rahmat all who came 🙏
Rahmat Aizada. My Iradi is still chala but I asked for boorsok in Iradi and the boy laughed 😂
That is how you learn 🧣
[sticker: jailoo]
Jailoo in the summer, Gulzada. Now it is the stable and the hay, but I like the picture
Who is going to the Hippodrome on 12 Dec? I want to see the Talas semi before I die 😂
Season ticket holders get the seats by the stands. Bakyt, buy the match ticket, not the potatoes
Potatoes pay for the ticket Timur. Rahmat
Talas and Nurzhan both 150 and 164 tonight. Air is bad. Night all, windows shut
Night Nurbek. Don't open the window for the smell of coal 🧣
Night everyone. Tomorrow is Friday, booth opens at 9. Changers rate tomorrow, don't ask me first
Night. Friday queue at the bank, I'll be there
Night. Shift at 8, the first phone of the day is always the same, a cracked screen 😅
Night all. Bars says night too 🐶
Night. Tyres on the rack, horses in, hay in. Good night Talas
Night. 6:10 bus, I'm going to bed like a horse
Night everyone. Saturday walk to the Old City at 11, bring the warm hats 🧣❄️
Night. Potatoes 2.10 tomorrow, rahmat all

nurzhan.t: Не спится. Окно открыл, а там запах как из нефтянки 🙃
Это не запах, это фильтр в Нуржане. Закрой окно, Костя
Доброе утро, Нуржан! На улице +1, дома +14. Кто сегодня без машины, в маршрутке не замерзните?
Доброе утро. Мы на Дастгохе, батареи чуть тёплые, но уже лучше
Доброе. Ночью смена была, устал как собака. Воздух сегодня 167, маска обязательна
Morning! Is the air always this bad here? In Talas it was better yesterday 🙈
Айгерим, в Таласе 112, там полегче. У нас в Нуржане зимой всегда так, привыкнешь
Нуржан 167, Талас 112, Иык-Жаныл 161. Тройка худших мест, но мы лидеры по PM2.5: 78.5 🙃
Слышал, в Иык-Жаныле двое задержали 2.4 кг героина на первой трассе. Страшно...
Айбек, не надо про это утром. Дети в школу собираются 😟
Да всё, молчу 🙂
Кто видел, в Таласе обсуждают, куда расти, на Микрорайоны или в поля к предгорьям? Герольд опять пишет
Нам бы сначала в Нуржане нормальные квартиры. 1-комнатная 750–1200 сом в месяц, это вообще реально?
Реально, если без ремонта и на окраине 🙃
Тарифы на газ для котельных так и не опубликовали. Кто-нибудь знает хоть что-то?
Нет, и совет молчит. Может, в понедельник что-то будет
Всем привет. Коллеги в лаборатории спорят, какой состав у монет Рабат-и-Сафеда. Кто-нибудь помнит, за что в прошлый раз ругались?
За то, что музей хочет забрать, а мы не отдаём 😄 Тайна покрыта
Игорь, ты тайны не разводи. Публикуем — отдадим
Is the Polytechnic course open for newcomers? I want to start Russian in the evening
Да, вечерние курсы для взрослых, записаться можно в деканате. Цена небольшая
Айгерим, хорошая идея. Я в своё время тоже так начинала 🙂
Rahmat! Will go on Thursday 🙏
Ребят, кто на Талас в пятницу? Маршрутка Талас–Нуржан 38, автобус 32, интересно что дешевле 🙃
Автобус дешевле, но ходит реже. Маршрутка с ворот 3 в Таласе
Ворота 3, запомнила. Айбек, спасибо
Яшка, на смене опять нормально. Талас сейчас в Лиге на втором месте, а Нефтяник чемпион. Пусть радуются 😄
Андрей, ты же сам сказал сезон закрыт. Не дави на Тулпар 😂
Всё, молчу. Чемпионы не давят
Бензин AI-92 сейчас 5.40 на Навбахоре. Заправилась, пока не подорожал 😅
Дизель 6.10, у нас в лаборатории считают, что до весны будет стабильно
Сдержанно сказал. Вот в Чатkal дизель 8.55–9.75, там вообще дороже
Ребят, в Иык-Жаныле вчера был ливень? Что-то сегодня туман и инверсия, дышать нечем
Yes, fog here too. Heavy. And cold
Ну что, на Талас 12-го кто поедет на плей-офф в ипподром? Айбек, ты решил?
Думаю. 12-го полуфинал в 19:00 и 21:00, Чу против второго из Highland, и Highland первый против Таласа. Интересно
Айбек, ты опять за 38 туда и обратно 😄
Зато с кофе 🙂

Lunch. Plov at my cousin's cafe is 28 som. He says the price is fine, the meat is the problem 🙃
Ice on the Tash-Kömür side this afternoon, slow and boring. Drink your tea and wait
[sticker: jailoo]
Potatoes at Nurzhan still 2.10 a kilo? Mairam asked and nobody answered her yesterday
2.10 they say. Cash only. Nothing else works in Nurzhan, I said it before
I'll ask Mairam to come with me then. Two sacks, cash, and we don't talk about Talas prices
Children are drawing the mountains with white crayon today. Nobody can tell what is snow and what is paper
[sticker: horse_love]
Chatkal survey adit at 800 of 1,500 metres. Iradenergo says it's a study, not a decision. I'll believe it when there's a contract
Adit is 800 m, the road to it is still a goat track. Nobody asked me
Donor cut the Talas hydrology grant 30%, to 420,000 dollars. Gauges stay, glacier work slows. Who measures the glacier now
Nobody. The glacier measures itself, we just get the bill
Dogs fed, potatoes sorted, one sack went soft. Life in the valley 😒
Kids went home. The bus to Talas was full again, 32 som and standing room only
Standing room costs 32 too. We're generous in the valleys
Chu v Highland place 2 is the play-off semi on 12 Dec, Talas hippodrome 19:00. Chu, you going?
If the road stays open. Chu is 26 on the ISEZ table and Talas is 25, they say it's going to be a fight
Chu 26, Talas 25 and the play-off is not even played yet. Toktosun, sit down
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Light off in Kara-Buura for an hour, then back. Could be the generator man again 😄
Not the generator man, the line. I'll look at it tomorrow if the road is clear
Toktogul power is fine tonight. Apa is cooking plov on the gas stove and it's perfect
Petrol AI-92 5.40 at Chu, diesel 6.10. My husband says he doesn't drive anywhere so he doesn't care. He cares
Tulparcoin is up to 3.52 cents this noon, down a bit. I still don't know what it is
It's not money, it's a game, my son says. You can't buy plov with it
Ulak Highland round 12 on Saturday, Akjele v Karakoyun at 14:00, Upper Besh-Tash. Akjele is always mud
Boztorgoy will win anyway. They have the best horses and the nicest hats
Gn soon. Tomorrow 30 kids and the stove works. Good day
Fergana Gateway still open. Chains on, Mairam, don't forget the cab kit again
I didn't forget, Ulan, you did, in my cab last week 😄
[sticker: bilbeim]
Gn all. Potatoes in the pit, dogs by the stove 🌙
Gn. Kids asleep, lights on, we're rich tonight 😴
Gn. Snow on the hills, sheep in the shed. Same as yesterday, good day
Dogs barking at something on the road. Probably a fox. Probably.
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on the window, the tap froze again 🥶
Kayırluu. Put the kettle on the stove before the pipes do it for you
Fergana Gateway: open, but chains from the tunnel up. Tash-Kömür side is black ice
Toktogul fog this morning, I can't see the school gate. 30 kids arriving like ghosts 😅
Fog in Toktogul, dry in Sary-Bulak. Our dam is 80.9% full today, the water is going down 69 million m³ a day btw
Thank you Sapar, now I'm worried about the water too
Worry about the lights, the water is fine. Power is normal in Talas, Nurzhan and Iyık Janyl today, no cuts
Normal in Talas. Normal in my head would be a cut at 18:00 like Chu 😒
Who got the Herald this morning? Talas air is 150 today, unhealthy for sensitive groups. Keep the kids indoors
Talas is 150, Nurzhan 164. Nobody breathes well in those towns in winter, I heard it's the coal and the cars
Here in Chu we breathe mountain air and the sheep breathe it too. Nicer than Talas 😄
Buyers at Kyzyl-Adyr still at 90 tyiyn. Toktosun went to see. Nobody's selling at that price, the buyers are just waiting
Grain harvest closed at 486,300 tonnes, the Herald says. Stores full, prices low. Full stores, low prices, I could have told them that for free
Full for them, yes. My cellar takes 4 tonnes. Where do the other 7 go
Potatoes at 2.10 a kilo at the bazar in Kyzyl-Adyr. That's the price for the ones who have a cellar. I have a pit
Pit is a cellar with more mud 😄
Kara-Buura cousin says he can start the cellar block walls in spring. Not before, the ground is frozen
Spring is far, potatoes are not waiting. Rahmat anyway baike
Marshrutka Talas–Kyzyl-Adyr 30 som today. Driver says the diesel was 6.10 this morning, the bus eats it
Bus Talas–Iyık Janyl is 45. Who is paying 45 to go and see a horse 😂
Your uncle's horse, Ainura, sold it last spring. Stop lying in the chat
[sticker: tlpr_down]
Hay in the valleys at 26 a bale now. Up from 25 on Monday. The sheep eat it at the same speed, the bales don't wait
Cut the hay, cut the sheep, cut the wedding budget. Same as every winter
[poll: Will hay go over 30 som before March?]
Yes. Vote yes if you want to be right, vote no if you have hay in the shed
Who saw the Irad Cup final date? Neftchi against Attelkom, 7 Nov, that's done. Old news now
Neftchi 2-0, I saw it in the bazar on the phone. My pupils were shouting in class 😅
Lunch. Bus driver's bread, 3.50 a loaf, still a good loaf
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar 22 a kilo, Ainura says. Who has walnuts to sell 😍
Ask my father. Walnuts are his second harvest, first is the apples he gives to the neighbours
Diesel 6.10 at the pump, petrol 95 at 5.85. The Herald says the fuel sales tax went up 9% in January–October to 468m som. Pump prices unchanged, so somebody is paying it
Somebody is us. Always us
Chatkal villages pay 8.55 to 9.75 for diesel, Herald says. And nobody counts it there. Interesting
Off-book fuel in the mountains, not my problem, I only fix lines 😄
Chu v Highland semi on 12 Dec at the Talas hippodrome. Mairam, your husband wants a ticket already
He wants to sit near Boztorgoy's fans. I told him no
Ulak table: Chu 26, Talas 25. Highland place 1 is Boztorgoy 30 for sure, they have the horses
Round 12 is Saturday. Boztorgoy v Moiynkum at 13:00, Moiynkum winter grounds. Easy for them 😏
Easy until it's mud. Akjele v Karakoyun 14:00 Upper Besh-Tash, I'm going for the mud
Tulparcoin is 3.45 cents at noon, down 2.2% today. My son says it's still a game
[sticker: haha]
Changers in Bazar-i Kalan 11.50 buy for dollars, 12.00 sell. Bank says 8.40 but nobody goes to the bank. The changer's rate is the rate here
My cousin goes to Kazakhstan for work. He says the rubles are what he cares about now. 100 rubles 13.25 buy, 14.45 sell
Passes: Suusamyr, Otmek, Karakoyun, Kara-Buura are shut for winter. Only the Gateway and the railway. Pack a flask
Railway on the winter timetable, my sister took the train to Talas today, she said it was on time 😲
[poll: Best way to spend a cold evening in Chu?]
Chatkal adit at 800 of 1,500 metres. Nobody has said who pays the rest. I'm just the driver
Same as the glacier. We fund the measuring and somebody else gets the report
Dogs out for a run in the snow. The taigan pup nearly ate a sack of walnuts that wasn't ours 😂
Kids are going home. Tomorrow a test on the verbs, God help me
Line in Sary-Bulak checked, fixed by the road. Light is back in Kara-Buura too, Jamilya you can unplug the generator man
[sticker: haha]
Herald: 118 teacher-trainers certified. Ministry wants 4,000 teachers by June 2027. Ainura, will you be one of the 4,000?
I am already one of the 4,000, Bakyt. Nobody told the ministry
Toktogul official held over a bribe, a herding family from Ozgörüsh reported him. Good for the family
Good for the family. Bad for the official's wife, she will be at the bazar all week telling everyone it's a mistake
Toktogul is a small place. Everybody knows the official and his wife
Light off in Chu again 18:00 to 20:00? Mairam says it's back
Back by 19:40. Light is fine, my stove is fine, my husband is fine. Nobody is fine in Kyzyl-Adyr with the potatoes
Toktosun says the 90 tyiyn buyers come back Friday. Or they don't. Nobody knows
[sticker: kalpak]
Irad League table after round 27: Neftchi 63, Tulpar 62. One point. Tulpar's fans are still awake
Neftchi won 2-1 on the last day. Tulpar's fans are still angry about the hat
Women play at the hippodrome too? Mairam, we need to go with the sheep
Sheep don't do football, Kubat. Go with your dogs
[sticker: bilbeim]
Gn soon. Snow on the Chu road, tractor parked, sheep dry. Same as yesterday, good day
Gateway still open, chains on. Mairam, bring the cab kit yourself this time
I did, Ulan. You borrowed it 😄
Potatoes in the pit, dogs by the stove, Mairam's sheep in the shed. Gn all 🌙
Gn. Tomorrow Chu v Highland is still not played, don't start again 😴
Gn. Kids asleep, lights on, we're rich tonight
Gn. Verbs test, the stove is warm, the reservoir is at 80.9% and I am not worried

horses.t: Morning. Frost on the Hippodrome paddock, the young ones are fine in their blankets
Morning! 2 days to Highland round 11 results, no wait, round 11 was Saturday. Round 12 is the 28th, Akjele v Karakoyun at Upper Besh-Tash 14:00
Karakoyun 9 games, Kerim. Still they will win
Karakoyun have a Karakoyun 'missing' result from Saturday, not received yet. Just wait
Still need hay. Chu side farmers still 22-23 a bale? Askat you know anyone
Ask Gulsara, her Akyel cousin sells in the valleys, hay 26 a bale there too. Not cheaper than Chu
Our colt ate his breakfast and kicked the door 😄 Good sign
Good sign. Check his temperature again at lunch, and no cold water
Talas air today AQI 112, Nurzhan 167. I'm not going out without a mask
Grandma says Nurzhan smog is worse than the fog on the Chu. Stay home kids
Practice Saturday in the cold. Pray for me again 😂
You fall off, we all see it on Tulpar live 📸
Live? Don't put it on the chat, my mother reads this room
Hippodrome power normal today, heaters on all night again. Good
Ulak ISEZ round 11 Saturday: Talas 10–6 Kyzyl-Adyr. Nurzhan 5–2 Semiz, Semiz still at 2 points, poor boys
Semiz riders are great at kyz kuu though, I said it before
Talas 26 points top of ISEZ with Chu. Nice
Reminder: colic cases this week at the Research Center are from wet hay. Check bales for mould before you stack them
That's why Marat got cheap hay offers from Kara-Bulak. Be careful Marat
I looked, Kara-Bulak station hay is dry. 26 a bale, delivery extra
Anyone going to Kara-Buura on the 30th? Chabysh cancelled, that's a shame
Snow on the Otmek and Kara-Buura pass is closed for winter. Old road only
Yes we go by the old road Sunday if dry. Two young horses need the run
Petrol AI-92 at 5.40 at the Talas station again. Diesel 6.10. The trucks are eating money
Tyre shop has the same problem. Customers come in with no money and cracked tyres 😩
Grandma says the Toktogul lake is 81.5 percent now, still going down. She watches it every day
The lake must be full for the summer, it always goes down in winter. Don't worry
Anyone know a Highland player from Chatkal Highlands? Their Naiman game Saturday is interesting
Chatkal Highlands v Naiman on the 28th at 14:00, Upper Chatkal. I won't be there, too far
Lunch. Mom made plov, 28 a plate at the bazar but she makes it better 😄
Your mom is the best plov seller in Talas, Aidana
Kyz kuu at a toi needs good plov, that is all I know
Highland round 11: Boztorgoy 11–4 Tanıp, Kökjal 11–6 Karatau Select. Akjele 7–7 Chatkal Highlands Select
Akjele drawing again. Their second row is not good enough
Karakoyun v Naiman not received yet, so nobody knows. Stop guessing
[sticker: jailoo]
Gulsara, temperature still normal? Moving well?
Yes, moving, and he tried to eat the blanket 😂
Good. That is a good colt
Hay at 26 a bale in the Chu valleys, but diesel to deliver it is 8.55 in the Chatkal villages. Who pays that
Nobody pays it, we drive ourselves 😩
Groom is still scared of me. Good, he should be 😂
You will not fall off if you hold the mane, Aidana
Tulparcoin is up 1% today, 3.55 cents. Who is buying? Not me 😅
Only on the offshore sites. Not money here. Don't believe the Tulpar price
Those are not Irad things anyway. Horses only please
Reminder, play-off semi 12 Dec at the Hippodrome, 19:00 Chu v Highland place 2, then 21:00 Highland place 1 v Talas. Tickets?
Tickets sold at gate 2 on the day, the old man with the grey beard said. Not online
Good. I still have the thermos
Kyz kuu demo at halftime on the 12th if they let me. Groom says he will hold the horse himself
Then I bring a camera 📸 Both of you are funny
Talas has the housing debate on the Herald today. Microdistricts or out to the fields. Horses need fields 😂
Horses would love fields. People in the Microdistricts need the lifts first
Talas is growing too fast, the hay trucks get stuck on the old road every week
Who watched the Women's League? Tulpar Talas 2–2 Akademiya, Universitet beat Iyık Janyl 3–2. Tulpar and Universitet are close
Tulpar 23 points, Universitet 22, I'm in Universitet, I have to say it 😄
Tulpar 23 is the real Talas. Universitet are students, they drink tea
Do not start that again. Last round was Attelkom 3–0 Neftchi in the women's
[poll: Who wins Highland round 12, Boztorgoy v Moiynkum Select at 13:00 on the 28th?]
Boztorgoy, obviously
Moiynkum have 3 points. Maybe they surprise us
Quiet night at the Research Center. Two horses with cough from the cold stable. Blankets off during the day, on at night
Thanks doctor. My two are fine, warm barn
[sticker: rahmat]
Anyone for Saturday at Besh-Tash? I'm leaving early on the old road if it stays dry
Snow on the Otmek ridge again. Old road maybe. Drive carefully
Night horse people 🌙
Night all. Stables are warm 🐎
Morning horse people. Frost on the Hippodrome paddock this morning, the lads are breaking ice on the troughs
Cold but clear here. My two wore their blankets all night, they look like old grandmothers 😂
Blanket on a Chongtor is an insult. We have stone hooves and stone hearts
Akjele 7–7 Chatkal Highlands. Draw again, my cousin in Akjele is crying into his tea
Moiynkum 6–5 Aksay Plateau, first win of the season? Good for them
Karakoyun v Naiman still not received on the sheet. Somebody at the Directorate is asleep
Colt is eating his hay well this morning. Good sign 🙏
Good. Keep the hay dry and the water warm. Wet hay is what gives colic, not cold
Morning! Fog at Talas airport, flights held until about 10:30. Check the board before you travel
Fog in town too, you can't see the Chatkal ridge from the bazar. Drive slow
Lunch break from the faculty. Anatomy exam Friday, I am learning the horse leg bones by heart 🦴
Leg bones are easy. Learn the teeth, the teeth tell the age and the vet cannot lie
Teeth are too boring. Shoulders are the nice part
Hay in the valleys is 26 a bale now, Askat was right, Chu side is cheaper if you carry it yourself
Only if you have a truck that doesn't die on the old road 😂
Who is going to Besh-Tash on Saturday? Kerim said the old road if it stays dry
If it stays dry. Snow forecast on the Otmek side though
We are not going, two young horses is enough work for me. Take photos 📸
Reminder: deworm before the frost, and check teeth of the young ones before winter. Vet clinic open till 18:00
Teeth again! The doctor is obsessed 😄
Tulparcoin 3.52 cents at noon, down a bit. Still not a horse price, thank God 😅
Nobody in this room buys tulparcoin, Dilbar. Buy a horse 😂
Women's League last round: Attelkom 3–0 Neftchi, Universitet 3–2 Iyık Janyl, Tulpar 2–2 Akademiya. Tulpar still top on 23
Universitet 22, one point behind. Still in the fight!! 💪
Who is coming to the Irad Cup final on the 7th? Neftchi 2–0 Attelkom was the last one I saw, we are going to Nurzhan for it
Nurzhan air is bad again, AQI 162 this morning. Kids should not play outside. Take a mask to the stadium
Same for horses. Dust and smog in the stable hurts the lungs. Keep the barn ventilated, not drafty
Kyz kuu demo for the 12th is on. Groom says he will hold the horse himself, I will show the grab 😂
I still bring the camera. Who wants the fire-warm seats at gate 2?
Gate 2, the old man with the grey beard. Tickets on the day. I still have the thermos ☕
Ulak Round 11 Sarybagysh 10 pts, Chubar 4–5 Sarybagysh. Good win for the Highland boys
Sary-Bulak 3–0 Köhne Diz in ISEZ too. Sary-Bulak are waking up 😄
Talas 10–6 Kyzyl-Adyr Saturday. We are 2nd in the ISEZ on 25, Chu on 26. Let's go!
[poll: Who takes ISEZ on the 12th-of-December semi, Chu or Highland place 2?]
Chu. They have the big horses
Highland place 2 is Tanıp or Karakoyun, they will be fresh and hungry 🐴
Talas roads are a mess after the frost. Walnuts in Toktogul at 22 a kilo, my cousin says the bazar is full, cheap this year
Walnuts for the kids, not the horses 😄
Quiet night ahead. Two horses with cough from the cold stable at the Research Center, blankets on at night, off in the day
Thanks doctor. My two are fine, warm barn
Night horse people 🌙
Night all. Stables are warm 🐎
Morning horse people. Frost on the car this morning, the barn water is ice again
Check the water buckets twice a day, horses drink less when it's cold and then they get colic
Our colt is eating hay like a grown horse now 🐴
Ask him if he wants a blanket, Akyel babies always want more
Nurzhan is smoke again. My eyes are burning just from the walk to the bus
Talas is ok today, air is clear. Horses don't like the Nurzhan smog anyway
Dust and smog in the stable hurts the lungs. Ventilate, not drafty. Same as yesterday
Ulak fixtures for round 12 are on the Jarysh page. Highland Saturday, Aksay Plateau at 13:00 vs Karatau
Chatkal Highlands vs Naiman at 14:00 at Upper Chatkal, far away but I want to see it
Boztorgoy at Moiynkum at 13:00. They will beat Moiynkum, it's not even a question
Moiynkum Select have 3 pts. Nobody is sure of anything in the Highland this year 😄
Tulparcoin 3.45 cents at noon, down 2.2% today. Still not a horse price 😅
Dilbar, buy a horse with it, you can't buy hay with it either
Hay in the valleys is 26 a bale now. Not cheap but better than last month
Chu side farmers still say 22-23 if you bring your truck, Marat. I said it already 😄
My truck is a Tyre shop van, it doesn't go to Chu. Thanks anyway 🐎
Groom from the Hippodrome says the kyz kuu demo on the 12th will go ahead even if it snows
Snow is good for kyz kuu. Less dust in the eyes 😂
You haven't been grabbed by a groom yet, Temir 😂
Irad Cup final on the 7th, Neftchi vs Attelkom. Gulsara you are still going to Nurzhan?
Yes, two buses and the colt stays home with my husband 😄
Take a mask to the stadium, Gulsara. Nurzhan 164 today, unhealthy
Ooba, I have the masks, my daughter bought a box of them
Two more cough cases at the Research Center, both from cold stables. Blankets at night, off in the day
My two are fine, I check them every evening 🐎
Who is going to Kara-Buura Sunday? Chabysh, 30 km? I'm out, the passes are closed for the winter
Not the passes, the old road is closed. We go by the Talas road, two hours more
Snow on the passes already. Hope the weather allows
Highland round 11 Akjele 7–7 Chatkal Highlands, Kökjal 11–6 Karatau. Boztorgoy 11–4 Tanıp, nobody can stop them
Tanıp will come back. They always do in the second half of the season
Chu on 26 in the ISEZ, we are on 25. Semi on the 12th at the Hippodrome, I want Talas vs Chu in the final
Highland place 1 will be Boztorgoy. Talas gets them in the semi. Calm down Aidana 🐴
Night is cold, Nurzhan air is worse. Nobody should open the windows
Anyone else's flat in Iyık Janyl cold? Rent is 600-1000 a month and the heating is still not warm
Iyık Janyl air 177 last check, the worst. Don't go out without a mask
Keep the horses away from the bad air too. Fresh water and a dry barn is all you need
[sticker: horse_love]
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar are 22 a kilo. Who is buying for the winter?
Walnuts for the kids, not the horses 😄
Night horse people 🌙
Night all. Stables are warm 🐎

football.t: Morning. Frost on the potato rows, the rest of the field is white. Who's going to Boztorgoy v Moiynkum Saturday?
Jolbors, 13:00, Moiynkum winter grounds. Bag of walnuts already packed 🐆
Moiynkum winter grounds, that's the one with the goat fence? 😂
Goat fence is the only fence that works there
Back from night shift. Table is 63 vs 62 and the cup final is the 7th, I'm sleeping now
Sleep well Andrei. Final 2–0 is still a nice thing to say to Attelkom fans lol
Бакыт, а картошка сколько сейчас на базаре? Мама спрашивает
Potatoes 2.10 a kilo at the bazar this morning, Vika. Tell your mum mine is better 😄
Она сказала что ты всегда так говоришь 🙈
Did anyone see the Nurzhan air this morning? Can't see the Microdistricts from my window
AQI 167 on the app, unhealthy. Wear the mask on the bus, not the scarf
Talas is only 112 here, so we're the lucky ones this week 🤏
Who's going to Kara-Buura for the Saturday? Nobody, I guess, with the pass closed to traffic 😂
Kara-Buura Pass is closed for the winter, you go by the Fergana Gateway with chains now
Lunch break at the Talasbank branch, queue of pensioners for the bread (nan 3.50 a loaf). Still better than my shift yesterday 😅
Round 11 was Nurzhan 5–2 Semiz, and Semiz is still 2 points in the ISEZ table. I'll say it till I die
Pablo we know 😅 maybe go and win one in January
Deportivo Semiz is not a sport, it's a lifestyle 😤
Coin court is 16 Nov, the Liberty name case. Still no injunction, we get a free afternoon in the courthouse again
Supporting both is still the Iradi way 😄
Кто идёт на женский матч? Универ против Академии в субботу? Или я уже опоздала
Women's League finished, Vika. Tulpar won the table 23 pts, Universitet 2nd on 22. Last round Tulpar 2–2 Akademiya
Ой, ну да. Мы с Аттелькомом проиграли 3–0 в последнем туре, стыдно 🙈
Attelkom 3–0 Neftchi women, yeah we had that one. Next season, Vika 🧣
Jolbors checking the bus: Talas to Kyzyl-Adyr marshrutka 30 som, but the 4 pm one is cancelled 🚌
That's the Talas bus schedule I was worried about 😂
Toktogul reservoir 81.5% full and dropping, 59 million m³ in a day. Hydro guys are happy, we can't complain about the power at least
Power is normal in Talas today. No cuts. That's the only good news of the week
Diesel 6.10 a litre at the station, wallet cries. Hay in the valleys 26 a bale, so the tractor stays home
Hay for the horses is the real price here, Bakyt. Our jailoo guys are counting every bale 🐴
Semiz is 2.4 kg heroin news from Iyık Janyl again? No, I'm not going there, thank God. Route 1 stays busy with trucks
Police should catch the rest. Ice on that road, nobody needs that 😤
Talas debate about housing again, up in the Microdistricts or out onto the fields? My mum says the fields, I say the Microdistricts with heat 🏢
Microdistricts. Fields are nice till the first frost and then your boots are full of mud
A 1-room flat in Talas is 1,000–1,500 a month, do the fields cost less? 🤔
Fields cost you the heating bill, azat, not the rent 😂
Derby on the 31st, we beat you 2–1 at NurGaz. Sorry Talas. You're still 62 vs 63 forever 🖤🧡
Still the 1 point. Hey, a Night game in December at the Hippodrome, 12 Dec, Chu v Highland place 2 at 19:00, then us at 21:00 🤍❤️
Cold but I'm there. Bring the thermos 🫖
Андрей, ты же ночью работаешь?? Как вы вообще смотрите матчи 🙈
Shift B, Vika. Recording the Irad League highlights on the phone at 3 am 😂
Night game on the 12th, cold, and the bus back to Talas stops at 22:00. Nobody tell me it's a good day to go out
Taxi from the Hippodrome in Talas starts from 15 som, we split it 🚕
Night all. Coin court 16th, scarves both sides 🤍❤️
Night. Potatoes still in the ground, I'm going to sleep like one 🥔
Кто не спит? Опять про дерби думаю 🖤🧡
Morning. Fog on the Talas side again, can't see the potato field from the window 😴
Fog at Talas Airport, flights held until about 10:30. Check the board before you travel
Good, so the bus is safe at least 🙄
Nurzhan is mainly clear, -4 at night. Cold but the sky is nice for once
The air in Nurzhan says 162 today. Unhealthy. Wear a mask on the walk to uni pls
[sticker: kalpak]
Hay is 26 a bale in the valleys and the jailoo guys still counting. Winter will be long 🐴
Don't mention Ermek's horses before my coffee 😅
Horses don't care about your coffee Pablo 🐎
Reminder: Chu v Highland place 2 on 12 Dec at the Hippodrome, 19:00. Tickets from the club desk
Cup final is on 7 Nov and it's done. Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom. I still feel it
Нефтяник 2:0, говорила же 🖤🧡
Attelkom fans went quiet after the second goal, I felt for them honestly
Kara-Buura 25 pts, 9th. Not a bad season for them after the Pass chaos 😂
Kara-Buura lads, keep your heads up, and bring the bus fare 😄
Lunch. Plov at the canteen is 28 a plate today, it was 25 last week, I'm not happy 🍛
Refinery canteen is always 28 now, Andrei. Bring your own nan
Nan is 3.50 at the bazar, I'm not carrying a loaf to shift B 😂
Women's League ended 10 rounds: Tulpar 23, Universitet 22, Attelkom 16. Tulpar won the title, Nazgul is proud 🧣
Azamat kızdar 🤍❤️ Tell the girls well done
Ulak in ISEZ: Chu leads on 26 points, Talas on 25, after 10 games. Round 11 is Saturday 21 Nov
Kara-Bulak lost 5-2 to Dastgoh? No, 5-2 Dastgoh won in Kara-Bulak. Ugh 😤
Yes Dastgoh 5-2 Kara-Bulak. Nothing for the Bulak lads this week 🐆
Semiz again, rain forecast and the pitch is a bog. I'll play ulak in the mud anyway 😂
Semiz has the bravest ulak players in Irad, that's the rumour 🏇
Rumour noted 😎
Donor cut the Talas hydrology grant 30% to 420,000 USD. Gauges stay but glacier work slows 😕
That's the glacier people's problem, not our problem. Nobody in Talas stops watching the weather though
Fog tomorrow again probably. I have bad sleep, I wake up at 5 with the air alarm on my phone 😩
Кто знает, когда откроют маршрутку Талас-Кызыл-Адыр? 30 сом, ещё не понятно
It's 30 som, runs at 3 pm and 5 pm, but Vika check the 4 pm one is cancelled 🚌
Спасибо, Ermek 🙏
Refinery pay day is still next week 😭 Hold the coffee 👀

chaikhana.t: Still awake. Mare in the stable is foaling soon, I keep checking the camera 🙈
Don't sit up all night, you have exams. Call the stable boy if something happens
Kayırluu tañ! Who's up before the sun? Tea is on
Talas clear today, high 7 they say. Good for the booth, bad for my hands, cold keys 😩
Kids need hats, the hats are lost again. Three children, zero hats
Baarıñarga! Remember Thursday 18:30 at Tündük, English/Iradi exchange, bring one new word each 📚
Nurzhan air is bad again today, 167 on the app. My cousin in Nurzhan has a mask on at breakfast
Нуржан 167 — это нехорошо. Детям в школу без прогулок, пусть дома сидят
Talas 112 that's fine for me. Tyre shop smells of rubber anyway 😂
Talas 112 is unhealthy for sensitive people baike, you're not sensitive, you're a horse 🐴
Changers at the bazar this morning: 11.50 buy, 11.95 sell for dollars. Euro 12.50 / 13.10. Nobody's smiling at the booth
Dollar is the same as yesterday, the same as last month. The Bank of Irad doesn't move, the changers move the mood
So if I want to buy a second-hand screen from Nurzhan I pay in som and cry
Rustam, just come to the booth, I'll be nice 😂
Lunch was lentil soup again. Kids ate it because there was bread with it, no other reason
У меня сегодня плов в столовой, 28 сом, неплохо для обеда
Plov 28 at the canteen? In my day that was a feast. Good plov needs a good zirvak, not a good price
Apples in Chu are 3.45 a kilo now, my students asked why apples are more expensive than bread 😂
Because bread is the government, apples are the farmers. Tell them that
I told them Marat said it 😂
Hay in the valleys is 26 a bale now. Last year it was 18. My horse eats like a king
Hay at 26 is painful. Buy now, don't wait for snow, the price only goes one way in January
Marat you say this every year and every year you buy late 😂
That's why I'm the experienced one. Tradition
Кто видел новость про Иык-Жаныл, героин на трассе? Страшно, два человека задержаны
Yes, on State Route 1. Our booth cousin drives that road every day. He doesn't like it
Let the police do their job. My children don't go anywhere near that road without me
Talas housing debate again, up in the Microdistricts or out onto the fields? I'd take a flat in the foothills if the bus came
A flat in the foothills with no bus is just a tent with a balcony 😂
We lived in the Microdistricts when I started at the school. The stairs were the only exercise I got 😂
Poll: Which should be the price of a 1-room flat in Talas, what you'd actually pay?
Vote: 1,000 or 1,500. Nobody votes 1,500 here, we are all lying 😂
Nurzhan flats are 750 to 1,200 a month, I'm moving to Talas so I can afford to cry at a lower price
Who's going to the Hippodrome on the 12th? Semi-final Chu v Highland place 2 at 19:00, then Highland 1 v Talas at 21:00 🏇
Both my horses are ready. Talas at 21:00 I'll be shouting 😤
Talas v Highland 1, you're going to lose your voice, Marat
Talas doesn't lose at home. Ask Aidana
Ask Aidana what, baike? I just do the rides 😂
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar are 22 a kilo. Who's making the bread at home this week?
My bag of walnuts is already in the car, Gulmira apa 🥜
Мой муж опять про лагман. Я говорю — плов, я сегодня за плов ещё раз 😂
Who has the Tulparcoin rate? It says 3.55 US cents offshore, +1%. Who buys that, I want to know
Not legal tender, Rustam. Don't buy it on a bus 😂
Potato farmer joke still stands 😂
Ulak tomorrow at 21:50 in the ISEZ table: Talas 10-6 Kyzyl-Adyr was Saturday, no, that's not tomorrow. Let me check the sheet
Aizada it's Saturday round 11 for ISEZ, next one is 28th for Highland. Relax 😂
Chu 26 points, Talas 25. Next match day for Talas is not this week. Enjoy your evening
Poll: Best thing to eat when it's -5 outside?
Плов
Lagman, obviously. Svetlana don't start again
Tea. Only tea. Plov is for people who have a warm kitchen
Wedding in Kyzyl-Adyr on Saturday, I'm the kyz kuu rider again 🙈 they need me on the white mare
Make sure the mare has her winter shoes, the Kyzyl-Adyr road is icy
She has them, Marat. Stop managing my life 😂
Ещё раз про сериал: на IradOne в субботу новая серия про врачей. Гулзада, смотрим?
Kids asleep, I'll watch. Only if the Nurzhan doctors speak properly this time 😂
Tea at seven, ulak at nineteen, bed at eleven. I said it again. Who's awake?
Still on my bench in Talas, phone repair until 9. The heating in this room is a joke
Heating on in the booth too. I have three coats on at the counter 😩
Neftchi won the league, Tulpar one point behind. Gone and done. Next season we shout louder 🏆
Women's league: Tulpar 23, Universitet 22, Attelkom 16. Tulpar were 2-2 with Akademiya, they should be more careful
Жаль, женская команда хорошая, но ничья — не поражение
Kids are asleep, the house is quiet. Who here reads the Talas Herald? Is the housing article true?
Gulzada, if it's in the paper it's true, that's the law of the chat 😂
Nurzhan 167, Talas 112, Iyık Janyl 161. Everyone wear the masks outside, the air is not a joke 🙈
Iyık Janyl 161, this is why Talas is better. Still going to my bench
Rustam, Talas is also 112. Don't be dramatic 😂
Bread with walnuts tomorrow. Marat, don't forget the bag
Bag is in the car. I'm going to bed 🥜🌙
Спокойной ночи всем 🌙 Завтра аптека с утра
Jakshı tünö ☕🌙
Jakshı tünö, booth at 9, the changers can wait 😴
Bed at eleven. Aidana, go to sleep 😂
Going baike 🌙
Night everyone. Tomorrow the phone shop opens at 8, I'll be the first to be sleepy 😴
Kayırluu tañ! Oatmeal on the stove, come and get it before it sticks
Gulmira apa I'm already at the booth, the changers opened at 8 and I'm frozen 🥶
Then take the bread with you, the nan from the corner is still warm
Fog at Talas airport again, my cousin's flight is held. Check the board before you go anywhere
Fog in Talas and I'm walking to the counter in it. Good morning anyway ☕
Talas fog, high 5 today, low minus 5 last night. Kids in three layers, my youngest in a hat 😂
Nurzhan is mainly clear and 8 degrees. Wrong city for a fog, Gulzada 😄
Ой, в Нуржане 161 по воздуху, дети в садик в масках. Не нравится мне это
Air in Nurzhan 162 and Talas 164, both unhealthy. Masks on the walk, please. Aidana, is it true the Tündük café has purifiers?
Only one, Aizada, and the horses don't get a mask 😂
Changers in Bazar-i Kalan this morning: dollar 11.50 buy, 11.95 sell. Begaiym, is that right?
Yes, and the euro 12.45 / 13.05. Nobody buys dollars before lunch, they just stand and look 😩
My cousin in Kazakhstan asked me for the rate. I said ask the booth, the booth is never wrong 😂
Sell the apples before the cold gets into the stores. Apples in Chu 3.45 a kilo at the bazar now, I bought ten
Gulmira apa, what are you going to do with ten kilos? Pies for the whole street?
Pies, compote, and the rest I give to Aidana's horses
The horses say thank you 🏇🍎 Please don't give them the green ones
Anyone else read the Talas Herald this morning? Grain harvest closed at 486,300 tonnes. So why is diesel still short?
Потому что склады полные, а солярки нет. Зерно есть, а машины стоят 🙄
Diesel in the Chatkal villages is 8.55 to 9.75 a litre, my customers are crying. Tyres don't cost less
Marat, stop selling me tyres, I walk to work 😂
Lunch is plov from the pot, Gulzada's recipe, I did it my way with short-grain rice. Come, it's still hot
Gulmira apa, I'm in Talas with a broken Samsung on the counter 😭 Save me a plate
A plate is 28 som at the bazar, I will not sell you mine, come and eat
Did you toast the rice in the zirvak first, Gulmira apa? Or are you cheating again
Of course I toasted it. The old Chu way, don't teach me
Thursday exchange at Tündük, 18:30. Bring one Iradi word and one English word, I'll bring the tea 🍵
My word: tyiyn. Aizada, what is tyiyn in English? Don't say penny
Ha, I was going to say penny. Let's say small change, it's close enough 😂
Сегодня в аптеке очередь за витаминами. Все кашляют, у меня в смене 40 человек за день
Mom says the same, everyone in the Iradi family has a cough. Drink the honey tea, Svetlana
Petrol AI-92 is 5.40 and AI-95 is 5.85 at my station. Still no change at the pump, the tax news says 9% more
Marat, the tax is on the year, the pump is the pump. Don't start a fight in the chat
No fight. I'm happy the pump is the same. A man can be happy 🙂
Roads record 2022-26: 340 km paved, 38 snowploughs. Good, but my street still has the hole by the school
The hole by the school has been there since I was in school 😂
It was there when I cooked at the school canteen, 1990. Nobody fixes the hole
Lucky I'm in the booth, it is -1 at the bus stop and the bus is late again 🥶
Talas bus is 32 to Nurzhan, marshrutka 38. I take the marshrutka, it's warm and it does not wait
Marshrutka to Kyzyl-Adyr is 30 and the driver sings the whole way, it's better than the radio 😂
Wedding on Sunday at Shamaldy-Say, the kyz kuu is mine again. Pray for my horse, the snow is heavy there
Your horse is not the problem. You are the problem 😄
Rude, Marat. I'll send you the video of me winning 🏇
Ребята, а кто пойдёт на игру в субботу? Нуржан - Темиржолчу, нет, я путаю
Svetlana, the Irad League is over, Neftchi are champions. Next game is the Irad Cup final if you mean that, 7 Nov is done
Ой, да, я помню. Просто скучаю по футболу 😅
Kara-Buura has no football until next season. I still eat the pies I baked for the match, mine are sad now 😂
Ulak in the Highland Conference: Boztorgoy play Moiynkum on Saturday 13:00 at the winter grounds. Who's going?
The Highland ulak is a beautiful thing when it's not raining. Boztorgoy 30 points, they will win
Boztorgoy are top, but Tanıp won 22 points and they are not going to sleep 😂
Kids asleep at 19:00 today, a miracle 🙏 Who's watching the Saturday series on IradOne?
Я смотрю! Но мне кажется, врачи опять говорят неправильно
Mom says the same. Gulzada, the Nurzhan accent is still fake
Aidana, you are going to get me banned from my own sofa 😂
Who wants a good Jasil recipe update? I found my mother's, she used tarragon and a little mint, like Svetlana said
Вот видишь, Рустам! Тархун и мята 🌿
Rustam, make the Jasil for the booth, I'll pay you in tyiyn 😂
Toktogul reservoir is 81% full and going down. Hydro is fine this winter, my father says the water is not a problem
Your father again 😂
Tea at seven, ulak at nineteen, bed at eleven. Who is still up?
Still in Talas, phone repair until 9 and then the bench
The heating in the booth is on, but the door is open all day, I'm freezing 😩
Jakshı kech! Tomorrow's English lesson is about weddings, bring your best toi words
Toi words? I know a few, my husband was the best toastmaster in Chu 😂
Gulmira apa, the toastmaster stories again 🙈
Ask the Talas airport board, flights are back from 10:30 this morning. Nobody will tell you this at the counter 😂
Ulak on Saturday, Akjele v Karakoyun at Upper Besh-Tash 14:00. I'll be on the bench with a flask
Rustam, bring the flask for me too 😂
Last one: the Talas Herald says Family-violence reports up 17% to 2,940 this year. Police say more people call now, that is a good thing. Be kind to your neighbours 💛
Правильно, если люди звонят, значит знают куда. Надо, чтобы все знали про этот телефон
Agreed. Gulzada, thanks for sharing that. Good night, everyone 🌙
Bread with walnuts tomorrow. Walnuts at Toktogul bazar are 22 a kilo, Marat, don't forget the bag
Bag is in the car. Going to bed 🥜🌙
Спокойной ночи всем 🌙 Завтра аптека с утра
Jakshı tünö ☕🌙
Jakshı tünö, booth at 9, the changers can wait 😴
Bed at eleven. Aidana, go to sleep 😂
Going baike 🌙
Night everyone. Tomorrow the phone shop opens at 8, I'll be the first to be sleepy 😴
Kayırluu tañ! Bread is warm, I baked the nan at 5, come get it before the kids eat it all
Gulmira apa 😩 I'm at the booth at 9, can't come. Save me one end piece
Доброе утро. Тумана в Токтогуле нет? Муж собирается ехать через перевал
Toktogul is fog, the bus driver says the road is ok, slow down at the bends
Jakshı tañ! Today's English word: 'frost'. Use it in a sentence before lunch 😄
Frost is what my hands are today. Cold stable mornings 🥶
Ice on the Talas windows again. My kids want to make a snowman, I said wait for snow first
Coming from Nurzhan this month, the air is different here. Talas is -4 at night and I still like it
Cold is good for the nan, it keeps longer. Drink your tea, all of you ☕
Changers this morning: dollar 11.50 buy, 12 sell. Euro 12.50 / 13.10. Hands are frozen, the till is slow
Begaiym, the euro for the Almaty trip? Ask your mum, she is paying 😂
Not for Almaty, for the Iradi women's team bus 😂 Aidana, you go and see the exchange rate yourself
Аптека открыта. Пришли три человека с кашлем, у всех одно и то же. Пейте тёплое
Honey and lemon, Svetlana. And the kids need hats 🧣
Tyres: winter tyres still in the shop, people come in asking for chains. Fergana road needs them, the sign says so
Chains or winter tyres on the Fergana Gateway, Marat? Good to know for my students driving to Ala-Bel
Yes Aizada, chains or winter tyres. The pass is closed in winter anyway, so don't go over Kara-Buura
Lunch: plov from yesterday, reheated with a little water. Not as good, but not bad 😅
Plov at a counter is sad. Phone repair goes on with a cold hand, the screen is soldered by a numb finger
Rustam, a plate of plov is 28 som at the canteen by the bus stop. Cheaper than a screen
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar are 22 a kilo. Gulmira apa's bread needs a whole bag 😂
Exactly. I'll make the walnut bread for Sunday's table, Marat brings the bag from the car 🥜
Коллеги спрашивают, как долго будет держаться холод. Я сказала: до весны, мы же в Нуржане хоть не пятнадцать градусов
Nurzhan has the smog, the sky is grey all day. My eldest coughs when he goes out to school 😩
Air in Nurzhan is 164 today, unhealthy, and Iyık Janyl is 177. Talas is 150 for sensitive people. Mask on for the children
Маски и много воды. Дети пусть не бегают на улице после обеда
My horse does not like the smoke either. The Hippodrome stables smell of coal, not hay
Hay in the valleys is 26 a bale. My two horses eat through it like it's nothing. Long winter ahead
Anyone watching the ulak? Akjele v Karakoyun Saturday at Upper Besh-Tash, Akjele is in the top half
Rustam, you said that yesterday 😂 I'm sure you'll bring the flask again
Ulak Saturday 14:00 for the flask, Rustam. Bring two
Ulak scores I don't follow, but I know who on the bench cheers the loudest 😂
Reminder: Thursday English/Iradi exchange at Tündük café at 18:30 tonight. Bring a word, take a word 🙂
Аизада, я приду. Могу научить английскому слову 'аптека' 😂
Kids are home, the radiator is warm in the kindergarten room but the corridor is still freezing. Heating on since autumn
My counter door is open all day too. Same as Begaiym, the booth is cold
Tulparcoin is 3.45 cents this noon, down 2.2 on the day. Still not money, my uncle says. Still a joke 😂
Still not legal tender, Marat. Please don't pay the walnut man in Tulparcoin 😂
Evening tea soon. Aidana, is your mother still watching the Nurzhan doctors on IradOne tonight?
She is, Saturday is the new episode but she watches the repeats too 😂
Ушла в Тундук. Аизада, до встречи
Home. Changers closed at 7. Dollar 12 sell at the morning, I wanted to tell someone 😂
Fuel: petrol AI-92 at 5.40 at the pump, diesel 6.10. My tyre shop still runs the truck on it
Diesel in Chatkal villages is 8.55 to 9.75. Sadly I don't drive there, my cousin does. He says it's a lot
Fuel tax up 9% to 468m som in Jan–Oct, the Herald says pump prices are unchanged. Good, but the bus fares went up in my head 😅
Taxi from 15 som in Talas and the marshrutka Talas–Nurzhan is 38. Gulzada, your head is right, the bus is 32
Grain harvest closed at 486,300 tonnes. Stores full, but the diesel is not cheap, my husband says
The stores are full, the hay is not. Ask the Chu farmers about the hay price, they don't laugh
Wedding season: I ride kyz kuu at the Talas toi on Saturday. Everyone wants the old Ak Börü, Rustam will be sad
Ak Börü or Shyñgyr-Shyñgyr, I'll be on the dancefloor either way. Bring the flask
Aidana, if you ride kyz kuu, Talas toi is the good one. Nurzhan toi has too much Russian pop
Нуржанские свадьбы — это отдельная история 😂 Русский поп до двух ночи
Hey, the Herald says the ministry has trained 118 teacher-trainers and wants 4,000 teachers by June 2027. Aizada, that's you in June
Ha, I'll be teaching the trainers' English then 😄 Who is taking the Thursday lesson tomorrow?
Gulzada, the bigger question: who is paying for the 4,000 teachers' tea 😂
The ministry, Marat. Hopefully with biscuits 🍪
Kara-Buura lost again? Ask Marat, he wants the football results on the radio 😂
Football: Neftchi Nurzhan are champions, 63 points. Tulpar 62 in second. The leader's gap was one point, it was tight 🏆
Поздравляю Нуржан! Но тульпар тоже молодцы, 62 очка это очень много
Tulpar and Neftchi, the Irad Cup final is 7 November, Neftchi 2–0 Attelkom. Already over, Marat, you're behind again 😂
Rustam, the cup final was on 7 November, I know. I just like saying Neftchi champions 😄
The Chatkal survey adit is at 800 of 1,500 metres, the paper says no contract yet. Let them dig, the wedding can wait 😂
Про Чаткал: пока нет контракта и финансирования, а туннель уже на 800 метров. Интересно, на что копают
Maybe they dig for the Chatkal diesel, nobody knows the price there 😂
Tomorrow is Friday! Tea at seven, English at nine. Jakshı tünö everyone 🌙
Night all. Kids asleep, the radiator is ticking. Stay warm 💛
Спокойной ночи 🌙 Аптека с утра
Jakshı tünö, booth at 9 and the changers can wait 😴
Aidana, bed. Your mother is watching the doctors already 😂
Going baike 🌙
Night. Phone shop at 8. Someone bring the flask on Saturday 😴
Jakshı tünö ☕🌙 Walnuts in the car
Last one: Toktogul reservoir 80.9% full, going down. Marat, your father says it's fine 😂
My father says it's fine every day, Begaiym 😂 Night
